sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; the baked payload is only the fallback when the tab is unreadable (never splice null). R35: payload gains optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series derived from the tab's Discount % column (HVAC col L / Plumb col Z, % of gross); rows hide gracefully when a payload lacks them

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R35 (2026-07-30): Discounts + Service/Install split. (1) Discounts above Revenue everywhere — full-width Summary tile ($ + % of GROSS = net + discounts, matching the new Discount column of the Sage history tab), two informational P&L rows above Total Revenue (GM math untouched), two Trends rows (Discounts $ informational g:0 · Discount % of gross g:-1, its $ reconciling against gross via the db flag) + a discount-lever insight (mechanical $/pt at current gross + OLS of variable GM vs discount rate, trailing 12). Discounts = counting + benign items, finance fees excluded. (2) Service vs Install card on Summary — job-attributed Labor & Purchases by BU (Install = *Replacement; Service = everything else incl. drain/misc/indirect), invBurn + rebate allocated by revenue share (exact), shared non-job labor stated not split, Svc+Inst = P&L totals. (3) SAGEH optional disc+gross keys; TR hardened: Branch rollup sums only keys on both trades, pick/live null-guard missing series (older payloads render without the disc rows). Verified 2026-07-30 jsdom A/B vs R34 on the July 07/01-07/29 exports (3,689 jobs, $5,427,932, GM 54.4%, gates 6/6 both): every pre-existing summary key and every shared Trends cell identical across both anchors and all three scopes; RAW identical modulo builtAt; disc/gross/dept reconciliations exact. Parsers, job-level math, GM/CP, flags, accrual, Handoff, review machinery untouched — June invariants unaffected. build.js and close.js run VERBATIM. Fetch path: authenticated git clone PRIMARY; decrypt+gate via tpl_fetch.js.
